name: laratribe/nativephp-auth
description: A drop-in Auth module (Login, Register, OTP Verify, Forgot/Reset Password) for NativePHP apps — one codebase for Android, iOS, and Web.

suggest.nativephp/mobile: ^4.0 — required only if you want the true EDGE/SuperNative screens (src/Native/*Screen.php). The plain web-view auth module works without it.
